annotation.title_clean: 95/216/EC: Commission Recommendation of 8 June 1995 concerning improvement of safety of existing lifts
annotation.title_en: 95/216/EC: Commission Recommendation of 8 June 1995 concerning improvement of safety of existing lifts
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 134, 20/06/1995
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Recommendation 95/216/EC urging Member States to ensure maintenance and improve safety of existing lifts according to annexed principles (car doors, cable inspection, presence detectors, accessibility for disabled persons, alarms, emergency lighting), referencing EN 81-1/81-2. Machine safety instrument unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States should ensure satisfactory maintenance of existing lifts
Lift safety should be improved per annexed principles, with EN 81-1 and EN 81-2 applicable for numerical values
Fit car doors, presence detectors on automatic doors, and devices preventing uncontrolled upward movement
Controls should be usable by unaccompanied disabled persons
Alarm systems linked to breakdown service and emergency lighting required; asbestos in brakes eliminated
